## MPC TOOLS 1.5.3

- **PotentialCrates joins the Plugins tab**, with the rest of the PotentialSuite: its version, **UPDATE**, **TEST**, **NEW VERSION** and **RECORD ON GITHUB**. If you'd already added it with **+ ADD A PLUGIN**, it now shows once, as part of the suite.

## Downloads

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.3-windows-x64.exe`
- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.3-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)
- `SHA256SUMS` to check the files
